2026_01_ATL_PIT.headline: Atlanta’s quarterback change shifts the burden toward Bijan Robinson against Pittsburgh
2026_01_ATL_PIT.paragraph1: Atlanta will start Cooper Rush after ruling out Tua Tagovailoa, forcing the Falcons to recalibrate an opener built around Pittsburgh’s aggressive front. Bijan Robinson and Kyle Pitts become even more important as outlets that can keep Rush out of obvious dropback situations. The Steelers are comparatively healthy outside Joey Porter Jr.’s questionable designation, so Atlanta’s clearest path is to stay ahead of the sticks, protect the football and prevent Pittsburgh’s pressure package from turning the quarterback change into a constant third-down problem.
2026_01_ATL_PIT.model_rationale: Pittsburgh can compress Atlanta’s margin for error by attacking a replacement quarterback, while the Falcons need Robinson and efficient early-down offense to stabilize the game.
